name: Kourou ELS (Soyuz launch complex)
best_known_for: Europe's Soyuz pad: first Soyuz outside Baikonur or Plesetsk (2011), 27 launches, eight for Galileo
credit: Ensemble de Lancement Soyouz (ELS) was the Soyuz pad at Europe's Spaceport near Sinnamary, French Guiana, a joint Russian-European project operated by Arianespace. Soyuz-ST flew from it 27 times between 21 October 2011 (Galileo IOV-1, the first Soyuz launch outside Baikonur and Plesetsk) and 10 February 2022 (OneWeb F13); 26 of the 27 flights succeeded. Russia suspended operations in February 2022, and Wikipedia reports the pad was demolished on 24 April 2026 to make room for MaiaSpace's Maia rocket. Sources: ESA (Soyuz page), Wikipedia (ELS and Soyuz at the Guiana Space Centre), Arianespace press releases as cited there; coordinates from Wikipedia and Wikidata.
